templates.mlkc: A cognitive mastery relation from a knowledge concept to a learner, where the relation strength denotes the learner's mastery level of the concept.
templates.exfr: A cognitive forgetting relation from an exercise to a learner, where the relation strength denotes the learner's forgetting degree for the exercise.
templates.rec: A recommendation relation from a learner to an exercise, where the exercise is recommended according to the learner's cognitive mastery and forgetting states.
templates.other: An unspecified educational relation between two graph entities.

source: V-Fin7 shared EKTM_mirt Bi-GRU relation templates
